# Lakshyaraj Singh Rao

> Backend & AI-Infrastructure Engineer based in Mumbai, India. Builds the
> reliability layer that lets AI systems run in production without supervision:
> refusal when retrieval fails, mid-stream guardrails, eval-gating before merge,
> and idempotency under webhook re-delivery. Co-Founder and sole engineer at
> Homesty.ai LLP (a live buyer-side real-estate AI on Next.js 15 + pgvector +
> GPT-4o). Author of seven open-source tools, four published on npm (two with
> SLSA build provenance) and one GitHub Marketplace Action.

## Open-source projects (all benchmarks are CI-measured, reproducible)
- Anchor — RAG layer that refuses instead of hallucinating when retrieval is below the similarity floor. Postgres + pgvector (HNSW). p50 2.6 ms retrieval at 100k vectors. https://github.com/ykstorm/anchor
- Anvil — idempotent webhook → BullMQ pipeline with HMAC verification, fixed-schedule retry, dead-letter replay. ~10.5k req/s ingress, constant-time HMAC (0.9% timing delta). npm @ykstormsorg/anvil (SLSA provenance). https://github.com/ykstorm/anvil
- Tripwire — mid-stream LLM guardrail that aborts a response the moment a rule trips (PII, prompt-injection, fabricated facts). ~4.7 µs per token. npm @ykstormsorg/tripwire. https://github.com/ykstorm/tripwire
- Goldset — CI for AI: golden-dataset, LLM-judge, and structural-assertion eval runners that gate merges. Deterministic runners clear 1k cases in ~3 ms; LLM-judge ~$0.00047/case on Claude Haiku. npm @ykstormsorg/goldset + GitHub Marketplace Action. https://github.com/ykstorm/goldset
- Quickdraw — LLM streaming benchmark CLI (TTFT, tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99, cost) across OpenAI + Anthropic. Live Claude Haiku: TTFT p50 739 ms, 85.6 tok/s. npm @ykstormsorg/quickdraw (SLSA provenance). https://github.com/ykstorm/quickdraw
- Stackup — full production Kubernetes stack on a laptop (ArgoCD, Argo Rollouts canary, Prometheus). Canary is CI-verified end to end: a real ≥0.95 Prometheus success-rate gate advances the rollout 25→50→75→100%. https://github.com/ykstorm/stackup
- Codecraft — in-browser Vite + React dev environment (WebContainers, Monaco, xterm). Cold boot ~51 s, warm <20 s via IndexedDB cache. https://codecraft-ai-tau.vercel.app
